loreJson.text: Acacia planks enclose a shallow hull, with two oars enough to carry two passengers across water.
Half the acacia hull is set aside for a chest, letting one rower carry a load across water.
A chest is tied to the bamboo deck, leaving one seat for the rower beside the load.
